# Dispatch 810 sources (byte copies)

This is the file the homepage's 810 strings were generated from. It was taken 2026-11-06.

COO dispatch 810 v2 §4 line 25 signs four strings:
- the third vertical badge, "series live";
- the singular form, "1 record";
- the re-signed P6 piece, "P6 defined;";
- the P6 card's description.

`scripts/status_copy_text.py` was generated from it by programmatic extraction (`scripts/gen_status_copy_text.py`); no string was retyped. `scripts/test_status_strings.py` re-derives every constant from this file, asserts byte equality and pins its SHA-256.

| Copy | Source | Bytes | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dispatch_810_20261106.md` | `Sustainable Finance Partners Business Apparatus/00_Operating_Model/CCO_DISPATCH_810_809_HANDBACK_3_RULED_Q_DEPLOY_B_BY_FACT_FIVE_PRS_CLEARED_31_PRE_ENGINE_SENTINEL_CLASSED_THREE_WITHDRAWN_RPS_NOTE_SIGNED_AUDIT_KINDS_PERMANENT_MIGRATION_RUN_BURN_RULE_20261106.md` (COO, 2026-11-06, v2; §4 "Product site #45" at line 25) | 9288 | `6812b2b25843eef76f5388a67ed21a71ba51c418b3f5ad386a19dbe3a8794361` |

The copy is LF-only, so its house pin (sha256 after CRLF→LF, first 16 hex) is `6812b2b25843eef7`, the pin dispatch 810 was received under.

`.gitattributes` marks `tests/fixtures/**` `-text`, so a Windows checkout keeps these bytes.

Do not edit this file. A corrected source is a new copy with a new hash, and the generated module is regenerated from it.
